title: Why is Starlink internet so important on the battlefield in Ukraine?
summary: It is the "backbone of military communications in Ukraine" that provides vital high-speed internet to forces across the country.

title: Dozens of children killed after roof collapses in Pakistani school
summary: At least 29 people, mostly children, have been killed after the school collapsed on them in Pakistan’s Peshawar.

title: Russia says Ukraine resumes attacks on oil refineries
summary: Ukraine's president earlier said Kyiv was 'done' with energy ceasefire and that strikes on Russian oil refineries would resume.

title: Could France trigger another Eurozone debt crisis?
summary: France's soaring borrowing costs and political divisions raise fears of a wider Eurozone debt crisis.

title: The irony of OpenAI crying foul over spying
summary: A company that owes its existence and enormous valuation to stealing others' work is now up in arms about theft.

title: School roof collapses in northwestern Pakistan, killing at least 29 people
summary: At least 28 students and one teacher killed in incident at Al-Khair Education Centre, a private school in Peshawar.

title: Russian nuclear-powered submarine fires missiles during Pacific drills
summary: Russia's Pacific Fleet has test-fired cruise missiles from a nuclear-powered submarine, striking a target 1,200km away.

title: From Morocco to South Africa, Israel election watched closely across Africa
summary: October 27 vote could test whether Israel's ties with African countries withstand the fallout from the war on Gaza.

title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
summary: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

title: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
summary: Livestreaming the execution of Nidal Hasan "will taint the honor of the military that employs it, and a nation that allows it," 72 former officers said in a letter.

title: At the Brooklyn novelty shop in 'surreal' row with Kelly Clarkson over mechanical bird
summary: Art of Play says its staff have been threatened after the singer complained online about how she was treated.

title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
summary: Buildings were set alight on the second day of demonstrations from thousands of students who want better university conditions and job prospects.

title: Haiti sanctions renewed: Starving the gangs of bullets
summary:
Haiti is living through one of the world’s most acute security crises.
Armed gangs control large parts of the capital, Port-au-Prince, and are pushing into rural areas, terrorising communities, killing people, committing rape and other sexual assaults, kidnapping for ransom and extorting individuals and businesses.

title: Colombia: UN independent experts call for Ecopetrol to provide reparations to victims of armed conflict
summary: UN independent experts welcomed on Wednesday a recent landmark corporate accountability ruling involving the Ecopetrol oil company by Colombia’s Special Jurisdiction for Peace, calling for reparations for victims.

title: World News in Brief: Gaza braces for winter amid attacks, joint patrols in CAR, 90 cities commit to sustainable development
summary: The UN and its partners are stepping up preparations in Gaza for the approaching cold and rainy season, even as attacks affecting civilians continue, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said on Wednesday.

title: DR Congo: Cholera cases spike amid fight against Ebola
summary: The cholera epidemic continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where more than 125,000 suspected cases and 3,644 suspected deaths were recorded between January 2025 and the end of September 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Wednesday.

title: Security Council LIVE: Libya in the spotlight amid ‘encouraging progress’
summary: Despite progress in the political process in Libya, institutional divisions, economic deterioration and security fragility continue to threaten stability, the UN envoy warned the Security Council on Wednesday, calling on Libyan leaders to overcome their differences to pave the way for national elections.

title: Yemen: WFP warns of potential ‘humanitarian catastrophe’ as fighting blocks aid delivery
summary: Intensifying fighting in Yemen has cut off life-saving assistance to 800,000 people as shifting frontlines, blocked roads and growing insecurity severely restrict access to the city of Taiz and other conflict zones, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) said on Wednesday.

title: WHO calls for urgent health action across the Eastern Mediterranean
summary: The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has called for promoting, providing and protecting health in the Eastern Mediterranean region, home to some of the world’s top humanitarian crises such as Sudan, Yemen and the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely
summary: As loneliness grows in China, a new industry is emerging to provide companionship and support.

title: Yemen: Houthi siege, cholera outbreak and aid cuts put civilians in the crosshairs
summary: Yemen’s southwestern city of Taiz is facing a “devastating” humanitarian crisis as escalating tensions are dramatically driving up food prices and causing shortages of supplies, the UN Spokesperson said on Tuesday.

title: 800 million young people face a future without jobs
summary: Approximately 800 million young people entering the labour market in developing economies over the coming years will not find jobs unless countries act, the head of the UN Development Programme (UNDP) warned on Tuesday, as the agency launched two initiatives to boost investment and employment.

title: ‘Need for UN has never been greater,’ UN chief says, proposing slimmer $3.3 billion budget for 2027
summary: Amid climate disruption, an AI revolution, war and growing hunger, “the need for the United Nations has never been greater,” Secretary-General António Guterres said on Tuesday, presenting a $3.3 billion programme budget proposal for next year – a cut of $40.8 million.

title: Colombia peace deal must endure as insecurity grows, Security Council hears
summary: Nearly 10 years after Colombia signed a historic peace agreement to end a decades-long insurgency, the deal is under strain from growing insecurity – and the UN’s top official in the country says it cannot be allowed to falter.

title: Security Council LIVE: Syria’s fragile transition – economic strain, Israeli incursions and progress towards elections
summary: The Security Council met to debate Syria's thorny transition Monday as it faces pressure on several fronts. Economic hardship is fuelling unrest, Israeli incursions continue in the south and sectarian tensions persist in Sweida, even as Damascus reports progress on its chemical weapons programme and talks about future elections. Millions, meanwhile, remain displaced. Follow live below and go here for full meetings coverage.

title: Sudan: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
summary: The risk of famine is growing in parts of Sudan already torn apart by war, as a severe El Niño drought makes life even harder in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, the UN-backed global hunger monitor warned on Monday.

title: ‘Efficiency has limits’: UNHCR chief warns refugee protection is buckling under cuts
summary: The money is running out faster than needs are growing: with 117 million men, women and children now forced from their homes, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) has received just $3 billion of the $8.5 billion it needs this year – and its chief, Barham Salih, warns that the global support system for asylum-seekers risks buckling.

title: Sustaining livelihoods amid crisis in Gaza
summary: Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin have different stories, but share a common thread: the determination to build something of their own and keep it going despite extraordinary challenges facing them in war-ravaged Gaza.

title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.

title: India: UN rights office urges release of ‘arbitrarily detained’ protesters
summary: The UN human rights office (OHCHR) has voiced concern over reports of mass detentions in India of demonstrators, protest leaders, civil society members, lawyers and journalists, before and during large-scale protests in Delhi on Saturday.

title: UN chief ‘gravely concerned’ by renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia, warns against escalation
summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has called for an immediate end to the renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia, saying he is deeply worried by reports that Eritrean forces are present in the country.

title: World News in Brief: ‘Horrific’ attack in Sudan, Israeli incursions in Syria intensify, most women and girls homeless in Gaza
summary: A suspected drone strike has left at least 40 dead in Sudan’s Blue Nile State – near the Ethiopian border - according to initial reports from the ground, according to UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric. Most of the casualties were women and girls.
